Finding: GET /members/{id}/loans and /members/{id} do not verify that the token subject equals the path id; any logged-in member can read another member's loans and address
Mitigation: Derive memberId from the JWT (prefer /me/loans); else enforce token.sub == id or return 403; add an automated authz test

Finding: Application Insights may capture full request bodies, query strings, or Authorization headers, exposing emails and addresses for the 90-day retention period
Mitigation: Telemetry initializer strips PII; never log bodies or Authorization headers; log memberId not name/email; document redaction rules

Finding: GET /members/{id} has no per-IP rate limit, allowing ID enumeration and mass PII scraping (compounds T1)
Mitigation: Front Door WAF rate rule 60/min per IP on member reads returning 429; add per-account cap

Finding: Public /health returns SQL and Redis up/down status without authentication (internal information disclosure)
Mitigation: Public /health returns {status:ok} only; keep detailed readiness behind auth or an internal network

Finding: No token revocation on logout; a stolen token stays valid until its 1-hour expiry
Mitigation: Keep short expiry; add refresh-token rotation and a deny-list for high-value actions on logout

Finding: Search filter GET /books?q= is at risk of string-concatenated SQL if not parameterised
Mitigation: Use parameterised queries everywhere; allow-list any dynamic sort/filter column names

Finding: Verify no .env or connection string is committed to the repo, and that App Service uses Key Vault references not plaintext App Settings
Mitigation: Key Vault references + system-assigned Managed Identity; add gitleaks to CI; rotate any exposed secret

Finding: App Service origin may accept direct HTTP, bypassing the Front Door WAF and rate limits
Mitigation: App Service HTTPS-Only on; restrict inbound to the Front Door service tag; verify X-Azure-FDID header; TLS 1.2 minimum

Finding: API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (wildcard CORS); any website could call the API from a browser
Mitigation: Set an explicit allow-list of origins (the BookSwap web app); never combine a wildcard with credentials

Finding: Missing security response headers (X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS); CSP flag is largely a false positive for a JSON API
Mitigation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and HSTS at Front Door; CSP not applicable to pure JSON responses
